dashboard.title: Growth Analytics
dashboard.subtitle: Real-time metrics for flow and value analysis

total.title: Total Registered
total.subtitle: Total base in CRM
total.help: Cumulative volume of all prospects captured in the EquineLead ecosystem. Consolidates both the historical CRM database and new entries captured in real-time by the scraping engine.

pipeline.title: Pipeline Value
pipeline.subtitle: Sum of SQL budgets (Hot) — USD
pipeline.help: Represents the projected sum of budgets for all leads currently classified as 'Hot'. It is a projection of the monetary value (in USD) ready to be managed due to its high conversion probability.

winRate.title: Global Win Rate
winRate.subtitle: SQL to Won conversion
winRate.help: Reflects the historical percentage of effectiveness in closing deals. Indicates how many of the qualified leads that entered the funnel ended successfully in a transaction.

score.title: Average Score
score.subtitle: Base quality (0–100)
score.help: It is the average quality rating (scale 0-100) of your entire database, evaluated by our Data Science engine. A high average indicates leads aligned to your premium catalog.

hotLeads.title: Hot Leads
hotLeads.subtitle: Proportion of the total
hotLeads.help: Shows the percentage proportion of leads identified by the AI with a critical purchase intent. Prospects that have exceeded the budget and activity thresholds necessary for top priority.

userDistribution.title: User Distribution
userDistribution.subtitle: Proportion between companies (B2B) and individuals (B2C)
userDistribution.help: Breakdown of the database between B2B (Companies) and B2C (Final consumers). Fundamental to adjust the commercial discourse and understand sales cycles.

funnel.title: Conversion Funnel
funnel.subtitle: Lead flow through pipeline stages
funnel.help: Visualization of the customer journey from capture to closure. Allows detecting leakage points and bottlenecks in the sales process.

interaction.title: Interaction Sources
interaction.subtitle: Distribution of leads by origin channel
interaction.help: Identifies the origin of leads and their preferred interaction channels. Compass to optimize investment in advertising and marketing.

classification.title: Classification Evolution
classification.subtitle: Historical trend of leads by temperature
classification.help: Historical trend of lead quality. Allows visualizing if the volume of 'Hot' prospects increases over time thanks to nutrition strategies.
